risk_context: MOCK DEMONSTRATION MODE: No material risk escalation forecast across the 5-day window - routine advisories only.

alerts.headline: No severe weather expected this week
alerts.message: WEATHER UPDATE: No severe weather expected over the next 5 days. Normal farming activity can continue. We'll alert you immediately if conditions change.
alerts.tone_rationale: A short reassurance SMS, matching the low-key channel farmers already expect, without implying urgency that isn't there.

alerts.headline: Routine conditions - no protocol activation needed
alerts.message: OPS BULLETIN: Forecast shows no material risk escalation over the next 5 days. No flood-response protocol activation required. Maintain standard readiness levels.
alerts.tone_rationale: Operational staff still need a formal all-clear bulletin so standing protocols are explicitly stood down, not just silence.

alerts.headline: No pre-positioning required this week
alerts.message: COORDINATION BRIEF: No material risk escalation forecast for the next 5 days. No relief resource pre-positioning required at this time. Routine monitoring continues.
alerts.tone_rationale: A brief routine status update keeps coordination partners informed without consuming a mobilization response.

alerts.headline: Routine - no special directives this week
alerts.message: ADVISORY: No material risk escalation forecast over the next 5 days. No special infrastructure or public advisory directives required at this time.
alerts.tone_rationale: Municipal corps still expect a formal advisory cadence, so an explicit routine status keeps the channel active rather than going quiet.
